scope: Uniform sharp class bounds for arbitrary finite quotients containing yz and a monic quadratic in x, over every field. Complete finite fans test joint ideal intersections, all-basis rank windows and sharp characteristic-zero products. No unrestricted G3 result, polynomial lower separation or novelty established.

uniform_theorem.all_order_ideal_bases: The same bound, with no coherence assumption.
uniform_theorem.joint_invariant: Y=yA, Z=zA; dim(Y intersection Z)<=2 and dim(Y intersection (Z+C))<=4, dim C<=2.
